analysis: OLS long specification with HC1 heteroscedasticity-robust standard errors

hypothesis_test.criterion: support requires a negative sd_gov coefficient and two-sided HC1 p < 0.05

interpretive_note: The supplied data already contain only Polity IV scores 9 or 10. The supplied R file runs both wave-7 exclusions; this analysis treats its first real-data run (excluding wave 7) as primary and reports the other as sensitivity.
